A second panel-data exercise with a more flexible functional form. Belongs to [Panel regression](../topics/50-panel-regression.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae11-panel-regression-part-2.zip" download>⬇ Download ae11-panel-regression-part-2.zip</a></p>
```

:::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio. Every path inside the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
::::
